## Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(patchwork)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())
```

## Read and load data

```{r}
FF_genomes_raw <- read.table('../../../Big_data/FlyingFlies_SNPtable.txt', header = T)

# Note: frequency here refers to Reference allele frequency. If freq is low, then alternate allele frequency is high. 
# This is based on the PERL code where:
# (line 56) my $TotalCount = $A + $B;
# (line 61) my $RefFreq = $A/$TotalCount

# N refers to total coverage:
# (line 62) $temp = $temp."\t".sprintf("%.2f",$RefFreq)."\t$TotalCount";

```

## Data cleanup and apply filters

### Create filters for allele frequency and read depth

Filters used (see Project Notes and manuscript for reasoning):

1.  Read depth between 20 and 500 (any site with any population outside these criteria are filtered)
2.  Allele frequency: at least one population should have frequency \>=0.02 and \<=0.98.

With this filter, 1,362292 SNPs remained. Total SNPs after selecting relevant chromosomes and dropping NAs are 1,423,464. A total of 61,172 sites were filtered out, which is approx. 4.3% of the unfiltered data.

In the following code, we have also included more conservative and liberal filter columns, but those are not used for the final filtering.

```{r}
# Remove all garbled chromosome names, as well as the 4th and Y chromosome. Set CHROM as factor for easier plotting later. Even though chromosome names have been filtered, the 'unfiltered' in the variable name here refers strictly to allele frequency and read depth. 
# Remove all NAs. 
FF_genomes_unfiltered <- FF_genomes_raw %>% filter(CHROM %in% c("2L", "2R", "3L", "3R", "X")) %>% mutate_at("CHROM", as.factor) %>% drop_na()

prefilter_length <- length(FF_genomes_unfiltered$POS)

# filtering out criteria: 
# read depth max at a site of 20x, min of a site of 500x
# ref freq avg. at a site > 0.01 and  < 0.99
min_depth <- 20
max_depth <- 500
min_avgfreq <- 0.01
max_avgfreq <- 0.99


# add tags for different criteria of filters
FF_filter_status <- FF_genomes_unfiltered %>% 
  mutate(
    # implement read depth criteria. A new column is made first to make the filter plots. \(rdepth) is a way to implement a temporary function with rdepth as the input (i.e., data in columns starting with "N_"). 
    # THIS IS THE FILTER USED
    rdepth_filter = if_all(starts_with("N_"), \(rdepth) between(rdepth, min_depth, max_depth)),
    # make average allele frequency column. UNUSED.
    avgfreq = rowMeans(across(starts_with("freq_"))),
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    # implement average allele frequency filter. A new column is made first to make the filter plots. 
    avgfreq_filter = between(avgfreq, min_avgfreq, max_avgfreq),
    
    # conservative read depth filter. UNUSED.
  rdepth_cons = if_all(
    starts_with("N_"), \(rdepth) between(rdepth, 30, 300)),
  # conservative allele frequency filter. UNUSED.
  avgfreq_cons = between(avgfreq, 0.02, 0.98),
  
  # liberal read depth filter. UNUSED
  rdepth_lib = if_any(starts_with("N_"), 
      \(rdepth) rdepth >= min_depth & rdepth <= max_depth),
  
  # liberal allele frequency filter
  # THIS IS THE FILTER USED
  filtfreq = if_any(starts_with("freq_"), 
      \(freq) freq > min_avgfreq & freq < max_avgfreq)
  )

# filter the data by rdepth_filter and filtfreq. This code will be called for loading the data for gene diversity, Fst and haplotype analyses codes.
FF_genomes_filtered <- FF_filter_status %>% 
  filter(rdepth_filter & filtfreq) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Nmiss, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, 
                starts_with("freq_"), starts_with("N_"))

filtered_out <- prefilter_length - length(FF_genomes_filtered$POS)

print(paste0(
  "Total number of unfiltered sites: ", prefilter_length))
print(paste0("Total number of sites after filtering: ", 
             length(FF_genomes_filtered$POS)))
print(paste0("Number of sites filtered out: ", filtered_out))
print(paste0("% of unfiltered sites filtered out: ", 
             round(filtered_out/prefilter_length, 3)))

mcols_rdepth_prefilter <- FF_filter_status %>% 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("N_")) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), mean))

m_rdepth_prefilt <- round(mean(unlist(mcols_rdepth_prefilter)), 3)


mcols_rdepth_filtered <- FF_genomes_filtered %>% 
  dplyr::select(starts_with("N_")) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), mean))

m_rdepth_filtered <- round(mean(unlist(mcols_rdepth_filtered)), 3)

print(paste0("Mean read depth before filtering: ",
             m_rdepth_prefilt))
print(paste0("Mean read depth after filtering: ",
             m_rdepth_filtered))
```

UpSet plots and Venn diagrams

Plots of unused filters are commented out.

```{r}
filter_criteria <- c("rdepth_filter", "avgfreq_filter",
                     "rdepth_cons", "avgfreq_cons",
                     "rdepth_lib", "filtfreq")


set_labels <- c("rdepth_filter" = "Depth filter",
                "filtfreq" = "Frequency filter")
# upset plot: final used filters: rdepth_filter, filtfreq
filters_upset <- FF_filter_status %>%
  dplyr::select(rdepth_filter, filtfreq) %>%
upset(
  filter_criteria[c(1, 6)],
  name = "Filters Applied",
  sort_intersections_by = 'degree',
  set_sizes = FALSE,
  labeller = as_labeller(set_labels),
  base_annotations = list(
    "SNP count" = intersection_size(
      mapping = aes(fill = intersection)
    ) + theme(legend.position = "none",
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          axis.text.y = element_blank(),
          )
  )
) + theme(panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank())


print(filters_upset)
```

#### Plot read depth and allele frequency with different filtering criteria

Histograms of read depth and allele frequencies after filtering

```{r}
FF_filtered_plots <- FF_genomes_filtered %>%
pivot_longer(
    cols = c(starts_with("freq_"), starts_with("N_")),
    names_to = c(".value", "Population"),
    names_pattern = "(freq_|N_)(.*)"
  ) %>% rename(depth_ = N_) %>% 
  mutate(ref_count = round(freq_ * depth_)) %>% 
  # Removes all text after the second underscore,
  # used to remove _G13_sample...
  # this leaves freq_CON1, N_CON1, and so on.
  mutate(Population = str_remove(Population, "_.*"))

text_labels <- tibble(
  x_pos = c(min_depth, m_rdepth_filtered, max_depth),
  y_pos = 15,
  label_text = as.character(
    c(min_depth, m_rdepth_filtered, max_depth)))

rdepth_hist <- FF_filtered_plots %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = depth_))  +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(log(count + 1))),
       fill = 'lightgreen', color = 'darkgreen', bins = 80) + 
  geom_text(data = text_labels, aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label_text),
            color = 'black', size = 5, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0) +
geom_vline(xintercept = c(min_depth, max_depth), color = 'salmon', linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m_rdepth_filtered, color = 'darkblue')+
  labs(x = "read_depth") +
  theme_cowplot()

print(rdepth_hist)

freq_hist <- FF_filtered_plots %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = freq_))  +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(log(count + 1))),
       fill = 'lightgreen', color = 'darkgreen', bins = 30) +
geom_vline(xintercept = c(min_avgfreq, max_avgfreq), color = 'salmon', linetype = 'dashed') +
  labs(x = "Reference allele frequency") +
  theme_cowplot()

print(freq_hist)
```

### Patchwork filters plots

```{r}
filters_fig <-wrap_elements(filters_upset)/rdepth_hist + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')

print(filters_fig)
```

#### Save filtered genomic data (VERY IMPORTANT STEP)

```{r}
# This is used for all downstream analyses
saveRDS(FF_genomes_filtered,
        file = "../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")
```

#### Save figure

```{r}
ggsave(filters_fig, filename = "../../Plots/f_upset_depth_fig.jpeg", dpi = 400, width = 10, height = 10)
```
